summary: The global marketing team is in a critical push to finalize Asia Start videos and the Intelligent China program while resolving an Outlook account lock and advancing the knowledge website redesign.
summaryDetail: The most urgent issue is the Outlook account lock, which requires immediate password resets and re-logins across all devices to restore access. In parallel, the team is wrapping up the Asia Start video series—final edits and sharing the final cuts are top priorities—and preparing the September newsletter for release today. The Intelligent China program is also ramping up, with a focus on gathering detailed program information and confirming copy for the Custom Program page. Longer-term, the knowledge website redesign is moving forward with a hybrid design approach, and the marketing strategy prioritizes Asia Star and Intelligent China, with conversion tracking audits and SEO plans underway. Upcoming milestones include the WIL Forum agenda discussion and the development of a comprehensive marketing plan for the priority programs.

meetings.title: Knowledge Website Design Review
meetings.summary: The team reviewed the current knowledge website design and Joseph's alternative layout, agreeing that the current design is largely similar to the existing one except for menu categorization. They decided to keep the current design but incorporate selected elements from Joseph's version, such as displaying more articles and featuring indices.

meetings.title: CKGSB Global Marketing Strategy Meeting
meetings.summary: The team discussed prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China programs for marketing, with a focus on SEO and conversion tracking. They agreed to audit existing tracking setups and develop a strategy to improve visibility.
